title: CARVED ICE CHOIR — crystalline glacial cavern decorations

coordinate_contract.ordering: terrain rectangles, then ordered features; last write wins
coordinate_contract.empty: unwritten cells are not erase commands
coordinate_contract.orientation: as authored only; no proven rotation/mirroring
coordinate_contract.anchor: ground at local bottom y=height; ceiling at y=0; not proof of structural support

style_guide.theme: A blue-black naturally carved glacial cave shaped like an immense silent instrument
style_guide.primary: BasaltColumns 100 / Slate 49 frame FrostedGlass 121 and QuartzCrystal 122
style_guide.accent: optional Water 3 / Slush 21 reservoir and Dust 14 / Stone 13 falling notes
style_guide.rhythm: one ceiling note for every two floor silhouettes, >=24 cells of negative space between long motifs
style_guide.ratio: visual target 55% open cave air, 25% dark stone, 15% crystalline ice, <=5% mobile fill
style_guide.negative_space: preserve empty cave void; never paint an Obsidian background behind playable space
style_guide.orientation: no flips without rewriting anchor/collision rules

features.title: Ribbed choir vault

variants.note: Replace snow teeth with stable glass

features.visual_effect: Five uneven hanging quartz notes framing a cavity
placement_rules: Anchor cap against a continuous real ceiling
Keep >=24 empty cells below longest rib
No hot fluid or salt contact without tests
features.simulation_notes: PackedSnow 105 is fixed but reacts to Fire, Lava and Salt.

features.title: Seven-note ice organ

variants.note: Replace active Ice with fixed frosted glass

features.visual_effect: Seven alternating ice columns in a descending rhythmic cascade
placement_rules: Grounded overhead cap required; leave 18-cell clearance below tips
Groups spaced >=130 cells; no hot neighbours
features.simulation_notes: Ice 9 has an active thermal kernel and may melt or freeze adjacent sampled Water.

features.title: Bellstone triad
features.visual_effect: Central glass bell flanked by two unequal harmonic sentinels
placement_rules: Leave >=12 cell lateral air margin
No sound or collision trigger implied

features.title: Rime fan moraine
features.visual_effect: Five light feathers fan outward from a stepped snowbank
placement_rules: Floor anchor uninterrupted
No active Salt on PackedSnow without reaction trial
features.simulation_notes: PackedSnow 105 immobile but converts on Fire/Lava or Salt pair contacts.

features.title: Counterpoint crystal span
features.visual_effect: Tall mineral bridge creates a true empty arch
placement_rules: Anchor both separated feet to proper floor
Clear host before painting; centre void is not an erase
Actor and Rapier clearance unproven
features.simulation_notes: Inert cells are not automatically a structurally load-bearing physical bridge.

features.title: Sleet reservoir
features.visual_effect: A turquoise liquid plane bracketed by black stone and a fractured ice lip
placement_rules: Only in explicitly cleared host space
Dry variant for gallery contexts
Measure Water mass, Slush movement, leakage and phase conversion
features.simulation_notes: Water 3 is FreeMass; Slush 21 is CellularYield; Ice 9 phase changes. Native containment untested.

features.title: Falling dust notes

variants.note: Sand/Salt dynamic alternative; thermal tests needed

features.visual_effect: Two vertical strokes of falling coarse and fine material hitting a resonator dish
placement_rules: Initial powder locations do not survive active ticks
Test settled geometry and revalidation
No Salt next to PackedSnow without paired-interaction checks
features.simulation_notes: Dust 14 and Stone 13 are moving powders and will resettle.

features.title: Echo stelae

variants.note: Amber coloured solid, not a real light

features.visual_effect: Four uneven columns, repeating the roof organ at ground level
placement_rules: Space after large empty interval
No acoustic behaviour or authored emissions
features.simulation_notes: Default fixed kernel-none cells; no fluid or smoke.

scene.title: The Sundered Canticle — acoustic halo and glacial transepts
assembly_notes: Continuous ceiling / floor anchors at y=36 and y=260
Dry reservoir and fossilized fall shown in combined preview
Preview sky is unwritten EMPTY; no automatic host clearing
No tested player or Rapier passages
Flagship: asymmetric strata, fractured mineral halo, old inspection walks, and separate written/unwritten air pockets.
Added composition materials are source-pinned kernel-none fixed solids, not real ice, music, glass lighting or thermal simulation.

limits.proposal_schema: not an importer, GEN resource, CYSD1 save or production demo
limits.simulation: no native ticks, Godot or Rapier executed
limits.stability: inert-static = immovable kernel-none cells only; no support or actor clearance guarantee
limits.source: current native material.hpp authoritative; shadow catalogue source-derived
interactions: Ice 9 thermal hot-neighbour melt / sampled Water freezing
PackedSnow 105 reacts to Fire, Lava, Salt; Steam contact may condense
Water 3 FreeMass vs Slush 21 CellularYield are distinct
Dust 14 and Stone 13 are moving powders
